editorial.name: Transistor
editorial.descriptionZh: Transistor 是播客托管与分发服务：上传一集就推到 Apple Podcasts、Spotify、YouTube、Overcast、Pocket Casts，另带自动生成的播客网站、单集下载统计与会员制私有播客。
editorial.takeawayZh: 用一张仪表盘截图说清分发、网站与分析
editorial.noteZh: 首屏是整幅深色照片，一位戴耳机的女性对着麦克风，左上角一枚黄色横条写 Video podcasting is here! Learn more，大标题 Publish your podcast everywhere，标题下并排 YouTube、Spotify、Apple Podcasts、Pocket Casts 四枚平台标，按钮是黄色 Start 14-day free trial 与 Chat with us。右下角叠着一台笔记本界面：左侧 Overview / Episodes / Analytics / Team / Social / Integrations / Website / Settings，主栏 Your Awesome Podcast 里写 All-time Downloads 418,629、Episodes 109、Scheduled 0，下面一张 Past 14 Days of Downloads 柱状图。再往下逐个功能段：Distribution（Your simple dashboard for managing distribution of your podcast to apps & players.）、Private Podcasts、Host multiple podcasts on one account、Website Builder（Choose a design and we'll automatically generate a website for your show.）、Analytics（See your average downloads per episode, popular podcast apps, number of subscribers, trends.），页尾给 Starter / Professional / Business 与 Subscription Add-ons、Enterprise 几个档位名。
editorial.pricing: Trial：Start 14-day free trial，档位在 /pricing（Starter / Professional / Business / Enterprise 与 Add-ons），首页未列价

reasons.statement: 首页交付的是 Transistor 自己的功能分段、后台截图与客户引言，用户拿走的是这一页的叙事与版式；来源是落地页灵感目录 saaslandingpage.com，属产品与公司官网。
导航只分 Features / Pricing / Company 与 Sign in、Start Free trial，页尾全是博客与帮助文档入口，没有可下载的设计资源或组件。
